title: A several-part split sends a covered part to neither the reader nor the researcher
goal: In a several-part kb_ask.py split, each part goes where its own route sends it: a clean good part and the kb has words of a split part to the reader, a web part and the kb lacks words to the researcher, never a web part's kb has words to the reader; agent_bench.route mirrors it; test_kb_ask_route.py plants a covered part beside an uncovered one.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_ask;q='(1) What is the default Windows LAPS password length? (2) How do I run the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler on AWS EKS with spot instances?';s=kb_ask.split_prompt(q,kb_ask.plan(q));assert 'LAPS' in s.split('The kb lacks')[0].split('Answer only')[-1],s[:400]
